title: Firecracker
description: AWS’s KVM-based microVM manager; boots MicroVMs in ~125 ms and powers Lambda and Fargate. Built on KVM, it boots in about 125 ms with a 5 MB guest footprint.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Cloud Hypervisor
description: A Rust VMM from the rust-vmm project aimed at cloud workloads with vhost-user device offload. Built on KVM, it boots in about 150 ms with a 8 MB guest footprint.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Kata Containers
description: Runs each container in a lightweight VM, blending container UX with hardware isolation boundaries. Built on QEMU/Cloud-Hypervisor/Firecracker, it boots in about 300 ms with a 64 MB guest footprint.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: gVisor
description: Google’s user-space kernel intercepts syscalls so containers run with a reduced host attack surface. Built on user-space kernel (Sentry), it boots in about 200 ms with a 32 MB guest footprint.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: crosvm
description: ChromeOS’s Rust VMM for running Linux and Android guests with virtio devices. Built on KVM, it boots in about 120 ms with a 8 MB guest footprint.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: QEMU microvm
description: QEMU’s microvm machine type strips legacy devices for a minimal, fast-booting VM target. Built on KVM/HAXM, it boots in about 400 ms with a 16 MB guest footprint.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: StratoVirt
description: A Rust VMM supporting both standard and micro VMs with hot-plug device models. Built on KVM, it boots in about 180 ms with a 8 MB guest footprint.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Hyperlight
description: Microsoft’s library for embedding tiny Hyper-V-isolated guests inside a host process. Built on Hyper-V/WHP, it boots in about 50 ms with a 4 MB guest footprint.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: vmm-reference
description: The rust-vmm reference VMM showing how to assemble a minimal KVM guest from crates. Built on KVM (rust-vmm), it boots in about 100 ms with a 4 MB guest footprint.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: OSv
description: A unikernel running unmodified Linux ELF binaries on a single-address-space kernel. Built on unikernel, it boots in about 250 ms with a 32 MB guest footprint.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Unikraft
description: A modular unikernel SDK composing minimal images from micro-libraries per application. Built on unikernel, it boots in about 80 ms with a 4 MB guest footprint.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: MirageOS
description: OCaml unikernels compiled to Xen, KVM, or Unix with type-safe network stacks. Built on unikernel (OCaml), it boots in about 60 ms with a 8 MB guest footprint.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Nanos
description: A unikernel that runs Linux binaries as single-process VMs with a tiny kernel surface. Built on unikernel, it boots in about 90 ms with a 8 MB guest footprint.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Nitro Enclaves
description: EC2 enclaves carve CPU/memory-isolated VMs with no persistent storage or network for secrets work. Built on Nitro hypervisor, it boots in about 500 ms with a 64 MB guest footprint.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Weave Ignite
description: Ran containers as Firecracker microVMs via a containerd shim for VM-grade multi-tenancy. Built on Firecracker + containerd, it boots in about 350 ms with a 32 MB guest footprint.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.
